# Using The Repository Harness

<!-- Generated by repo-harness-builder; source: core/docs:3.0 -->

## Workflow

1. Start or resume with `repo-harness-builder-session-start` and state the objective. It recovers relevant context and reconciles it with current repository evidence before work continues.
2. Use `repo-harness-builder-documentation` when durable documentation or visible project state needs updating.
3. Pause or close with `repo-harness-builder-session-stop`. It verifies the final evidence and saves a reliable handoff for the next session.

Recover context when you enter, and save it when you leave.
